title: skills/objectstack-formula: say timestamp() refuses a date field and teach isoDate(addDays(...)) for date shifting
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kgF3mo9f7LXuv5hac

Filing gate: ① (named location; the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #34447 / #34363).

**Where:** `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the built-ins line that lists `timestamp(s)`. Also the "Shift a date" guidance, if it does not already say this.

**What changes:** PR #34447 makes the formula gate refuse `timestamp(record.<date field>)`, including inside `+ duration(...)` arithmetic, as `date-text-call`. A date field reads `YYYY-MM-DD` text, which `timestamp()` refuses on every run. The fix the refusal names is `isoDate(addDays(record.<field>, N))`. The skill lists `timestamp(s)` and says nothing about this. Once #34447 merges, add one sentence: `timestamp()` takes ISO datetime text; for a date field, shift with `addDays`. Use the words of `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` in that PR.

**Business reason:** AI-authored stacks write `timestamp(record.borrow_date) + duration('168h')` (cloud#4717). The skill is what they read.

**Reader who acts:** the skills lane, after #34447 merges (a `domain:skills` PR). Triage first-touches the grade.

**Dedupe:** searched open issues for "timestamp date field skill": none.
